name: Daytona Desktop
description: Run a Daytona cloud sandbox desktop from your phone: full noVNC screen, or tap-to-click Computer Use. Sends your Daytona API key and input to app.daytona.io.
author: Mobile SSH

settings.label: Daytona API key
settings.help: Create one at app.daytona.io → Keys. Stored encrypted on this device (Keychain / Keystore) and sent only to app.daytona.io. A Daytona API key is organisation-wide: anyone with it can create, read and delete every sandbox in your org.

settings.label: Screen quality
settings.help: How much data the tap-to-click screen uses per frame. Low ≈13 KB, Medium ≈20 KB, High ≈150 KB. The full VNC desktop is unaffected.

settings.label: Auto-stop after (minutes idle)
settings.help: New sandboxes stop themselves after this many idle minutes so you are not billed for one you forgot. Careful: work running INSIDE the sandbox does not count as activity — only opening this plugin, the desktop, or an SSH connection does. So a long job left running with the plugin closed will be stopped anyway. Raise this, or use 0 (never auto-stop), if you need unattended work to survive — and stop the sandbox yourself when done.

settings.label: Auto-delete after (minutes stopped)
settings.help: Delete a stopped sandbox after this long. -1 disables auto-delete.
